text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- More than half the population entitled to vote registered on electoral lists.
- Secretary of Libyan Popular Committee Abdelmajid al-Gu'ud on two-day visit to Morocco at invitation of Prime MInister Filali.
- Consumer price index expected to rise during fasting month of Ramadan.
- Foreign investments register remarkable progress but remain fragile because of lack of legal framework.
